items.reviewNote: Il cita le passage explicitly reports citation of the supposed Aristotle text. The earlier VII citait authority/citation bank was read in all three bands. Add this past-simple surface to the same planned proper citer verb meaning, with no tense-only identity. Every verb takes le; using a textual reference differs from disregard, erasure or rejection. Citation does not establish that the attributed passage or page is genuine.

Le passage is the text excerpt supposedly cited from Aristotle, not a physical crossing or the passage of time. No global or earlier proper passage noun exists. Passage/volume/ouvrage/traité are masculine singular nouns after un; a short extract differs from the complete bound volume or intellectual work. The bank identifies textual scope without approving the quotation’s attribution.

Je n’entends pas trop bien le grec means limited understanding of Greek, not intention or merely hearing sound. The exact entends mean/intend bank and VI understand bank were read in all three bands. Add the surface to the planned understanding meaning under proper entendre. Entends/oublie/ignore/altère are vowel-initial singular predicates fitting l’; grasping meaning differs from forgetting, ignorance or alteration. Negation and degree do not create another sense.

Both le grec and en grec name a language, not an adjective modifying a following noun or a person of Greek nationality. No global or earlier proper grec owner exists. Prepare the proper French language noun. Grec/français/latin/russe are masculine singular language nouns after le; the named speakers distinguish Greek without implying mastery by the quoting philosopher or verifying the source quotation.

La mite philosophique metaphorically names the tiny human philosopher from the giants’ perspective. Académie1762 defines historical mite as a nearly imperceptible small insect, without requiring modern moth or arachnid taxonomy. The VI mites metaphor bank was read in all three bands. Add the singular surface to that same planned proper mite noun meaning. Mite/géante/planète/montagne are feminine singular nouns after une; minuscule scale differs from a giantess or huge landscape/celestial object.

Le Sirien reprit les petites mites describes physically taking the recovered humans again, not restarting speech. The global take-back/buy-back definition and all three merchant-return questions were read alongside the exact speech bank. Add this physical retaking context on the same existing reprendre taking-again core, with definition-scope normalization beyond commercial return and whole-family impact review before import. All plural-object predicates fit les; reacquisition differs from release, dropping or uninterrupted retention. The two earlier speech uses keep their speech identity.

Pourquoi citez-vous Aristote asks why the speaker invokes an authority in a language he admits not understanding. The earlier VII citait bank and all three questions were read. Add this plural-present surface to the same planned proper citer reference meaning, with no person- or mood-only sense. All four vous predicates take le; quoting as reference differs from disregard, rejection or criticism.

Répliqua le savant directly names the learned philosopher, with irony in the context. No global or earlier proper savant noun owner exists; savant merely appearing as an adjective distractor elsewhere is not an owned noun. Prepare proper nominal ownership, separate from the later feminine adjective savante. Savant/ignorant/novice/élève are masculine singular nouns in un; deep knowledge differs from ignorance or a learner’s beginner status. The character label does not certify genuine understanding of the cited text.

Il faut bien citer reports the philosopher’s ironic rule for citing what one does not understand. The earlier VII citait bank and all three questions were read. Add the infinitive on that same proper planned citer meaning, without an infinitive-only or irony-only sense. All four infinitives take le; textual reference differs from disregard, erasure or rejection. The bank explains citing without endorsing the speaker’s practice.

La langue qu’on entend le moins is a language poorly understood, not the bodily tongue. The proper global language noun and all three langues questions were read. Add the singular surface on the same existing meaning. Langue/image/date/route are feminine singular nouns after une; linguistic communication differs from visual representation, a calendar point or a path. Singular number does not create a fresh sense.

Qu’on entend le moins means the language one understands least. The global hearing/intention meanings and earlier VI understanding bank were read in all three bands. Add this third-person surface on the same planned understanding meaning as current entends, with no person-only identity. All four singular predicates fit l’; comprehension differs from forgetting, ignorance or alteration. The superlative degree does not mean a different kind of understanding.

Le cartésien is the nominal philosophical follower who takes the next turn. Académie1762 explicitly records the masculine noun for a philosopher attached to Descartes’s principles. No global or earlier proper cartésien owner exists. Cartésien/péripatéticien/leibnitzien/lockien are masculine singular follower nouns; the named doctrine selects the target. Do not conflate the noun with the modern adjective describing a rigorous method or endorse the speaker’s account of prenatal ideas.

Un esprit pur is asserted to be without material admixture. The global water-purity meaning and earlier VII pures abstract-unmixed bank were read in all three bands. Share the earlier planned unmixed meaning under the same proper pur adjective, with no spirit-only or masculine-only new sense. All four predicates agree masculine singular; absence of mixture differs from mixing, alteration or impurity. The philosophical characterization remains the speaker’s claim.

Both ventre de sa/ta mère situate the claimed prenatal knowledge in the maternal womb, through the ordinary abdominal-region noun. No global or earlier proper ventre noun exists. Ventre/menton/genou/coude are masculine singular nouns after le; the front region below the chest differs from chin, knee or elbow. Prepare one ordinary belly meaning with the maternal context explained, not a pregnancy-only sense or a claim that prenatal philosophical knowledge exists.

Métaphysiques qualifies idées as concerning the soul, being and general first principles. Académie1762 records the adjective separately from the feminine noun naming the discipline. No global or earlier proper owner exists. Prepare the proper adjective lemma, not nominal discipline ownership for this modifier. All four predicates agree feminine plural; the philosophical first-principle scope differs from immediate practice, matter or sensory experience. No endorsement of innate knowledge is made.

Obligée d’aller à l’école expresses compulsion in the philosopher’s account of the soul, not performing a favor or inspiring gratitude. The global compel/help meanings, their banks and I obligé_compelled bank were read. Add the feminine participle on the same existing French obliger compulsion sense, not a gender-only meaning. All four predicates fit elle est…de la faire; obligation differs from liberty or exemption. The doctrine remains attributed to the speaker.

À l’école names schooling in the cartesian’s account, not a school of philosophical doctrine such as the Cartesian school. No global or earlier proper école noun exists. École/église/épicerie/écurie are feminine singular vowel-initial nouns fitting l’; regular education differs from worship, retail or housing horses. The shared noun is not narrowed to a particular age or an asserted prenatal/postnatal theory.

Apprendre tout de nouveau is learning again, not teaching/informing someone else. Both global apprendre owners and their meanings, the learning bank and earlier II/III learned/found-out proposals were read. Select the broad acquiring-knowledge SNS_apprendre_primary, with duplicate lemma/sense consolidation before import while preserving prior mastery. All infinitives take cette connaissance without an elision filter; acquisition differs from forgetting, rejecting or concealing. The de nouveau components are handled by the earlier whole phrase.

Ce qu’elle a si bien su refers to the knowledge the soul supposedly already possessed. The global knowledge meanings and three questions, and earlier VII sachez bank, were read. Add this participial surface to the broad proper savoir knowledge meaning, with tense-only legacy labels normalized during impact reconciliation before import. All four participles fit elle l’a; knowing differs from forgetting, ignorance or denial. No claim that the knowledge actually preceded birth is made.

Elle ne saura plus means the soul will no longer know the earlier ideas, not the special inability construction ne saurait. The proper savoir knowledge sense and all three questions were read. Add the future surface on that same meaning, without a tense- or negation-only identity. All four predicates take la; possessing knowledge rather than future knowledge contrasts with forgetting, conjecture or seeking information.

Si savante qualifies âme as supposedly knowledgeable before birth. No global or earlier proper savant adjective owner exists; the current le savant bank is a noun and cannot own this adjective use. Prepare proper adjective ownership under French savant, separate from the nominal owner. All four predicates agree feminine singular; deep knowledge rather than ignorance, lack of culture or literacy selects savante. No learned-soul doctrine is asserted as fact.

Si ignorante describes lack of knowledge in contrast to savante, rather than innocence, stupidity or moral fault. The earlier I ignorant_unlearned plan and all three questions were read. Add this feminine surface to that same proper planned ignorant adjective meaning, with no gender-only sense. All four predicates agree feminine singular; lack of knowledge differs from learned, erudite or informed.

Quand tu aurais de la barbe au menton gives lexical possession of a bodily feature, not a compound-tense auxiliary. The existing proper avoir lexical family was compared with the exact auxiliary aurais bank. Add this conditional surface on the same have/possess meaning, with no conditional-only sense. All four vowel-initial second-person predicates fit tu l’; having a growing beard differs from awaiting or removing it.

Au menton names the lower face on which a beard grows. No proper earlier or global menton noun owner exists. Menton/front/nez/cou are masculine singular nouns after le; the part directly under the mouth differs from the forehead, nose or neck. Preserve the general chin meaning rather than a beard-only sense.

Qu’entends-tu par esprit asks the intended definition of esprit, rather than language comprehension or hearing. Compare the global mean/intend entendre bank and earlier VI understanding bank. Preserve the existing mean/intend sense with the exact qu’ source prefix; no contraction-only owner or meaning is made. The middle clue asks explicitly for the interrogative form indicating intended meaning; all four alternatives are elided que plus a vowel-initial second-person singular verb. Intended definition differs from forgetting, erasure or ignorance.

Que me demandez-vous là asks about the question just put to the Cartesian. The proper global question-asking meaning and all three stored banks were read; exclude asking for an object/requesting. All second-person plural predicates fit vous lui with an understood question or explanation: asking seeks the interlocutor’s answer, unlike answering, telling or explaining. Preserve the same asking meaning without a plural-only sense.

Très-bien answers whether he knows what matter is: the understood predicate is sais, so the reply means very well, not the possibility-intensifier in V il se peut très-bien faire. The proper global bien manner family and all three bands were read, as was the earlier V hyphenated bank and identity plan. Preserve exact hyphenated surface on the proper French bien adverb and existing well meaning. Before import, normalize the earlier V owner from très-bien to bien and compare possibility intensification with ordinary manner without inventing a spelling-only sense. All choices are adverbs compatible with connaît; thorough comprehension differs from poor, shallow or imperfect comprehension. The speaker’s confidence is not certified knowledge.

Voilà une pierre identifies an ordinary grey stone, not a precious gemstone. The proper global pierre physical-rock meaning and all three questions were read. Add an exact surface-context bank on that same rock meaning; no piece-only sense. Pierre/plume/feuille/fleur are feminine singular nouns after une. The existing rock middle bank includes mixed-gender distractors; full current/historical impact and repair are required before import rather than changing the shared template here.

Both grise qualify the stone’s colour. The proper global gris adjective and all three stored bands were read; exclude nominal colour gris and do not create a feminine-only sense. All four predicates agree with une pierre and differ semantically in colour.

Ses dimensions are the spatial extents of the physical stone, not social importance or a metaphorical scale. No global or earlier proper dimension noun was found. Dimensions/couleurs/odeurs/saveurs are feminine plural nouns after ses; length, width and depth distinguish spatial extent from colour, smell and taste. No plural-only meaning is made.

Pesante occurs twice in the enumeration of a stone’s physical properties. Académie9 explicitly separates the technical adjective having weight/subject to gravity from the everyday heavy sense. Prepare proper French pesant adjective ownership; the etymological peser participle is not its grammatical owner here. All four feminine singular predicates fit elle. Légère is intentionally excluded because a light material object still has weight. The bank identifies the physical property without claiming it exhausts matter’s nature.

Both divisible qualify the physical stone’s ability to be divided into parts, not integer divisibility or an inflected verb. No proper global or earlier divisible adjective owner exists. All four invariable singular adjectives fit elle and contrast division with inability to divide, cut or separate. Preserve the general physical meaning, without a stone-only sense.

Me dirais-tu bien ce que c’est asks the listener to state what the stone or matter is. The proper global dire speech family and existing three bands were read, excluding imply/entail. Add the conditional surface on the same say/tell meaning, without a courtesy- or conditional-only sense. All predicates fit tu me le; verbal communication differs from concealment, denial or refusal.

Quelques attributs refers to the visible properties just enumerated, in contrast to the essence of matter. No global or earlier proper attribut owner exists. Attributs/propriétaires/voisins/fabricants are masculine plural nouns after ses; properties differ from the people who own, neighbour or make a thing. Preserve the general property meaning, not a separate philosophy-only or plural-only sense.

M. Micromégas is the abbreviated civil title monsieur, with token M excluding the full stop and normalized form m. The complete published title bank was read. Its middle Mme/Mlle distractors are feminine and violate the noun alternatives rule, so add a contextual bank with M/Dr/Pr/Me representing masculine singular titles for a male addressee. A civil title differs from the doctor, professor or lawyer’s professional titles. Preserve capital M in display and the existing proper monsieur noun meaning; record whole current/historical title-bank impact and repair before import.

Un autre sage and le sage de Sirius name persons, whereas unit209 le moins sage predicates wisdom and retains the published adjective bank. The earlier I sages wise-people bank and identity plan were read in all bands. Add the singular noun surface to the same planned nominal meaning, correcting the earlier substantive-adjective route to proper nominal ownership before import. Sage/insensé/imprudent/ignorant are masculine singular nouns after un. No singular-only or philosopher-only meaning is made, and the label does not certify a character’s knowledge.

Le philosophe malebranchiste uses an adjective modifying philosophe, rather than a stand-alone follower noun. The primary nineteenth-century Larousse entry explicitly separates the adjective belonging to Malebranche’s philosophical system from the masculine follower noun; the reproduced Littré follower entry provides independent lexical comparison. No proper earlier/global malebranchiste owner exists. Prepare proper French adjective ownership. All four masculine singular philosophical-affiliation predicates fit ce philosophe; the named school distinguishes them. The bank does not endorse the character’s claimed divine agency.

Tout était fait uniquement pour l’homme claims that the physical worlds and stars were created for humankind. Compare the exact done/completed bank, global material-create family and earlier VII faire un livre bank in all three bands. Add a participial surface on the existing produce/create meaning, not a participle-only fresh sense. All four masculine singular participles fit ce monde était. The broad done family overlaps material production and needs full current/historical impact reconciliation before import; existing unrelated completed-work uses stay unchanged until reviewed. The speaker’s theological assertion is not certified fact.

Je fais tout en lui expresses doing every action in God, not making someone else perform an infinitive or cutting a figure. The exact causative fais and earlier appearance bank were read alongside the global activity meaning and three bands. Add this surface on the existing lexical do/perform identity, with no first-person-only sense. All predicates fit je la; accomplishing an action differs from avoidance, forgetting or concealment. The speaker’s agency account remains a reported claim.

Sans que je m’en mêle denies the speaker’s involvement in the actions he attributes to God. Prepare a proper French mêler verb owner and the pronominal participate/get-involved meaning, not physical mixing or an English lemma. All singular vowel/consonant predicates were checked in the complete je m’en construction; taking part contrasts with turning away, disinterest or withdrawal. The m’ pronoun and en complement retain their separate grammatical roles; no tense-only sense is made.

The second speaker adds that he too does not understand Greek. The earlier IV bank was read and retained unchanged in all three bands. It adds a second negation rather than expressing increased degree, immediacy or indefinite duration; plus does not receive a separate quantity encounter here. Package05 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

The Cartesian claim says the soul must learn everything again; tout remains the pronoun everything outside de nouveau. No adjective meaning new modifies an object here. All temporal phrases fit apprend; repetition rather than first occurrence, indefinite duration or anticipation selects the target. Package05 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

Micromégas takes up the reported attributes and asks for the underlying nature of matter. The formula advances the exchange, not a claim of good quality, proficiency or willingness. All complete interjections fit the quotation. Published bien discourse meanings must be reconciled into a full formula before import so one occurrence does not generate two encounters. Package05 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

The giant says the supposed prenatal knowledge was not worth the trouble if the soul becomes ignorant later. This is an evaluation of usefulness, not sorrow or a penal sentence; prepare the canonical être la peine/valoir la peine worth-the-trouble meaning with the negative occurrence recorded exactly. No negative-only fresh meaning or claim that prenatal knowledge actually exists is made. Every full predicate fits cela; useless effort selects the target. Suppress exact earlier component word routes before import. Package05 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

Le cartésien prit la parole introduces the next speaker in the philosophers’ exchange. Académie records prendre la parole as speaking or making a speech in an assembly. This is a complete idiom, not literal seizing, undertaking a commitment or resigning oneself. All four full past-tense predicates fit il; beginning speech rather than silence, departure or closing a book selects the phrase. Before import suppress the earlier isolated parole occurrence on this exact span and preserve all other speech-word mastery. Package05 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses; preserve whole-expression mastery and suppress only exact components before import.

Micromégas adressant la parole à un autre sage introduces speech directed to a specific listener. The VI parole spoken-word bank and the source context were read. Prepare the complete adresser la parole meaning and this participial surface under one planned expression owner; the later adressé variant shares that meaning without a tense-only sense. Every full participial phrase fits en lui; speaking to a person differs from denial, interruption or withdrawal. Preserve the other utterance uses while suppressing exact isolated component routes.

Quand on lui eut adressé la parole marks speech directed to the follower of Locke. This completed surface shares the same planned adresser la parole expression meaning as the current adressant variant, with explicit canonical owner reconciliation before import and no participle-only new sense. Every full participial phrase fits il lui a; speaking to the listener differs from withholding, interruption or turning away. Suppress exact earlier component routes while preserving other speech meanings.

The animalcule coupa la parole à tous interrupts the philosophers rather than cutting a physical object. Prepare the full idiom under proper expression ownership, compared with existing couper and parole meanings before import. All four full past predicates fit il leur; preventing completion of speech rather than granting time, answering or granting a delay selects coupa la parole. Suppress only the exact component occurrences and preserve all other literal cutting or utterance mastery.

Se laissèrent aller l’un sur l’autre describes the two visitors physically leaning together under convulsive laughter. Académie1694 explicitly records laisser aller for not supporting one’s body or posture. Prepare this full postural construction rather than ordinary aller movement or a separate laughter-only meaning; retain the source’s emotional cause without narrowing the canonical scope to it. All four complete plural predicates fit ils; giving way physically differs from upright support, straightening or stillness. Exact earlier component suppression is required before import.

Autant vaudrait ne pas être is the rejoinder that one might as well not exist if one has no independent agency. Académie9 explicitly records autant vaut/vaudrait followed by an infinitive as a preference locution. Prepare the complete autant valoir construction, with no conditional-only canonical meaning, instead of isolated equal-quantity autant and material-worth valoir. All four complete phrases take ne pas être; equivalence/preference differs from prohibition, impossibility or obligation. Suppress only the exact component uses before import.

reviewBasis: Full source thought units, independently written meaning clues, every middle alternative, noun number and agreement, distinct meanings and explicit ownership dependencies were individually inspected. Structural checks verify revision and coverage, never editorial approval.
